name: Size-Precision SLM Bench
description: is it better to run a Tiny Model (2B-4B) at High Precision (FP16/INT8), or a Large Model (8B+) at Low Precision (INT4)?"  This benchmark framework allows developers to scientifically choose the best model for resource-constrained environments (consumer GPUs, laptops, edge devices) by measuring the trade-off between Speed and Intelligence
